name: Basilica of St. Mary
history: St. Mary's is the oldest Catholic parish in Virginia, founded in 1795 by Francis Neale, president of Georgetown College. Its first brick church was funded in part by George Washington, with his former aide Col. John Fitzgerald collecting the funds. The parish moved to Royal Street, where Father Joseph Fairclough had built most of the present church by 1827. Pope Francis named it a basilica in 2017.
arch: A Gothic Revival stone church with a central tower and spire, within the Alexandria Historic District, a National Historic Landmark District.
features: A plaque honours George Washington as a subscriber to the first church.
The site of the first chapel became St. Mary Cemetery, the first Catholic cemetery in Virginia; Revolutionary War soldiers are buried there.

look.d: George Washington subscribed to the building fund of the first church.

fun: Bricks of the first chapel were reused to build the Alexandria Lyceum.
journal: George Washington chipped in. Virginia's oldest Catholic parish, Old Town Alexandria.
